name: Sputnik 1
notes: First satellite: silver-zinc battery + radio beacon in a sealed pressurized sphere. Trivial by design.

name: Vanguard 1
notes: First SOLAR-powered satellite — its signature breakthrough is elec_siliconPV.

name: Explorer 6
notes: First photo of Earth from orbit (spin-scan imager); solar paddles + spin stabilization.

name: Luna 3
notes: First far-side-of-Moon photos: onboard film development + first 3-axis attitude control in deep space.

name: Mariner 2
notes: First interplanetary success (Venus flyby): mid-course maneuver + Sun/Earth sensors + deep-space link.

name: Voyager
notes: Grand-tour flagship, deepest integration (~10 disciplines). tel_xBandDownlink is the T11 rung that actually opens X-band (commsTL7 + DSN ground TL7); the old note calling it a gap predated that node and was stale.
